description: No relative imports — use absolute imports from security_review
fix: Use absolute imports: from security_review.models.findings import ...

description: No direct import logging — use get_logger() from security_review.logging
fix: Replace with: from security_review.logging import get_logger

description: __init__.py files must be minimal — docstring and re-exports only
fix: Move logic to dedicated modules, keep __init__.py to docstring + imports + __all__

description: Only tools/runner.py may call asyncio.create_subprocess_exec — no other module may call subprocess
fix: All subprocess execution must go through tools/runner.py via run_tool(). Agents never call subprocess.

description: Never use shell=True in subprocess calls
fix: Use asyncio.create_subprocess_exec with list args. shell=True is a command injection vector.

description: tools/ must not import pydantic_ai — PydanticAI wiring belongs in agents/
fix: Tools are pure functions for subprocess execution. PydanticAI agent wiring happens in agents/*.py

description: agents/ must not import tools/runner — agents access external tools only via SecurityReviewDeps
fix: Agents use SecurityReviewDeps for file access and SAST findings. Tool execution is orchestrated by passes/, not agents/.

description: models/ must not import from passes/, agents/, or tools/ — models are leaf dependencies
fix: Models are pure Pydantic data structures with no business logic imports. They are imported by other layers, never the reverse.
